_comment: ACTIVE/DEFAULT ADCNN detection pipeline. This is the promoted current detector (the domain-adapted stage-1 + refit stage-2). Loaded by ADCNN/config.py:load_pipeline() unless ADCNN_PIPELINE points elsewhere. Model files are POINTERS into the frozen release models/v2_D/ (md5s in models/v2_D/v2_D_release.json are the immutable release identity). The prior baseline lives at models/legacy_v1/pipeline.json.
name: current

mf_len_debias._comment: Trail-length de-bias for THIS stage-1's ends-bloom: len_db = clip((raw_mf_length - offset)/slope, 0). Re-derived field-held-out on non-blind dev injections (residual ~1px over 6-60px). Travels with the model; do not mix with another model's de-bias.
